deadline.value: The graduate application deadline is December 1, generally for a start the following fall semester.
deadline.quote: The graduate student application deadline is December 1, generally for a start in the following fall semester.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

toefl_min.value: Non-exempt international applicants should have a TOEFL iBT score of at least 102 (out of 120), with a speaking score above 20.
toefl_min.quote: should have a TOEFL score of at least 102 (out of 120) with a speaking score greater than 20

ielts_min.value: The department's alternative is an IELTS score of at least 7.5.
ielts_min.quote: an IELTS score of at least a 7.5 or a Duolingo English test score of at least 120

supervisor.value: Direct-admission PhD applicants need a faculty letter of support; rotation applicants do not.
supervisor.quote: Faculty send the Graduate Admissions Committee a letter of support for Ph.D. direct admission applicants to their lab

funding.value: Support can come from a TA, RA or fellowship, but the page does not say most or all students are funded.

entry_route.value: A PhD takes 30 credit hours after an M.S. or 60 after a B.S./B.A.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. students entering with only a B.S./B.A. degree must complete 60 credit hours

also.quote: Ph.D. students entering the program who already have an M.S. degree must complete 30 credit hours

notes: Biological Sciences PhD. Application goes through the Graduate School; the department asks for three letters for PhD applicants. Toxicology and microbiology are mentioned only as course advice, so they are not separate records.
